title: Existence of normalized classical curve inverse image
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $D$ with base $k_0$, algebraic closure $k$ and geometric Frobenius [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, and an algebraic closure $\Omega:\operatorname{Type}(u+1)$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$. Let $X_0$ be a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme, $m\ge1$, $k_m=\mathbf F_{q^m}\subset k$, and $h_0:C_0\hookrightarrow X_0\times_{k_0}k_m$ a closed immersion with $C_0$ finite type over $k_m$. Use the common-stage constructible Weil heart [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex; def-weil-constructible-heart], classical lisse Weil sheaves and filtrations [def-zl-classical-weil-filtration-transport-data], and normalized classical realization [def-zl-normalized-classical-weil-realization]. Let $R$ satisfy the constant restriction specification [def-zl-constant-extension-restriction-local-data], and let $R_X,R_C$ be any supplied normalized realizations on $X_0,C_0$. Then there exists a $\mathrm{ZlCurveClassicalPullback}$ comparison [def-zl-curve-restriction-filtration-data] for these supplied realizations and $R$. For every classical lisse Weil sheaf $H$, the carrier of $R_m(R_XH)$ is common-stage lisse, where $R_m=h_0^*\circ R$ is the composite curve restriction [def-real-common-stage-lisse]. This asserts no filtration or local Frobenius spectrum formula. The same comparison supplies, at every algebraically closed geometric point $x:\operatorname{Spec}\kappa\to(C_0)_k$ with $\kappa:\operatorname{Type}(u)$, a natural isomorphism between the classical fibre functor after $c_{\rm classical}$ and the original fibre functor at $xh$. These are ordinary geometric fibres, not Frobenius operators.

proof.text:
Pull finite locally free systems back level by level along the geometric composite.
Their pulled-back trivializations and reduction maps define the ordinary classical
inverse image. Apply completed_system_comparison to compare completion and
rationalization with this inverse image. The normalized rational realization
identifies the resulting geometric functor with commonStageDerivedPullback.
Use hR's normalized constant comparison followed by the immersion pullback
compositor for underlying. Its composition equation is underlying_normalization.
The composition equations for the completed systems and realization, applied to
geometric Frobenius and the ordered m-fold Weil map, define classical on Weil
objects and give realization and realization_underlying, naturally on all arrows.
Use the supplied RX and RC normalizations, rather than choosing new realizations.
The same finite locally free models show the realized restricted carriers are
common-stage lisse. Empty schemes and zero ranks use the zero systems. At each geometric point, the ordinary pullback fibre comparison is natural in sheaf maps, at finite level and after completion, rationalization and scalar extension. Compose with c.forget to get the displayed natural isomorphism on classical Weil objects.

theorem zl_curve_classical_pullback_exists
    (R : sfCommonStageWeilSheaf D l hl X₀ Ω ⥤
      sfCommonStageWeilSheaf (constantExtensionDatum D m hm) l hl
        (constantExtensionModel D m hm X₀) Ω)
    (hR : ConstantExtensionRestrictionSpec D m hm X₀ l hl Ω R)
    (RX : ZlClassicalRealization D l hl Ω X₀)
    (RC : ZlClassicalRealization (constantExtensionDatum D m hm) l hl Ω C₀)
    : ∃ c : ZlCurveClassicalPullback D l hl Ω X₀ m hm C₀ h₀ RX RC R,
      (∀ H : ZlClassicalWeil D l Ω X₀,
        @IsCommonStageLisse l _ Ω _ _ _
        ((constantExtensionDatum D m hm).geometricFiber C₀).left
        (sfWeilPrimeInvertible (constantExtensionDatum D m hm) l hl C₀)
        ((zlCurveRestriction D l hl Ω X₀ m hm C₀ h₀ R).obj
          ((RX.weil D l hl Ω X₀).obj H)).obj.carrier) ∧
      ∀ (κ : Type u) [Field κ] [IsAlgClosed κ]
        (x : Spec (.of κ) ⟶ ((constantExtensionDatum D m hm).geometricFiber C₀).left),
      Nonempty (c.classical ⋙
          IsoAlgebra.forget (lisseAlgebraicAutomorphismPullback
            ((constantExtensionDatum D m hm).geometricFrobenius C₀) l Ω) ⋙
          lisseAlgebraicFiberFunctor l
            ((constantExtensionDatum D m hm).geometricFiber C₀).left x Ω ≅
        IsoAlgebra.forget (lisseAlgebraicAutomorphismPullback
            (D.geometricFrobenius X₀) l Ω) ⋙
          lisseAlgebraicFiberFunctor l (D.geometricFiber X₀).left
            (x ≫ zlCurveGeometricMap D X₀ m hm C₀ h₀) Ω)
